coupling.formula: shape(w) = base + w * protrusion + f(w) * sag
coupling.note: at w=0 the sag vanishes exactly; sag grows superlinearly so small bellies sit tight and large bellies hang

mobility_field.definition: per-vertex scalar in [0,1]: 0 = tissue anchored to skeleton (ribcage brim, spine, pelvis brim), 1 = fully mobile flesh. The paintable 'shape weight' of the AnthroForge weight-painting discipline -- distinct from rig skinning weights (see GRAVITY_WEIGHTS.md).
mobility_field.fold_repair: attenuation field: where the combined field flipped marginal faces on either base, local sag amplitude was turned down (min attenuation 0.54 over 197 verts) -- the same operation as painting influence down in dForce/Chaos; direction and shape of the sag are preserved
mobility_field.procedural_seed: morph mask x angular profile (front-weighted) x vertical profile (peak just below the navel h* - 0.06, gaussian sigma 0.15 torso units; ribcage taper above h 0.62-0.70; pelvis taper below h 0.22-0.30) x tissue-mass factor (0.30 + 0.70 * |delta_v1| / max), 6 graph-Laplacian smoothing passes
mobility_field.storage: canonical record carries the field per base as a sparse vertex-weight instance; the human-editable form is the paintable blend (vertex groups AF_mobility / AF_anchor + mobility_viz colour layer)

gravity.model: mobility-modulated analytic sag: sag_delta(v) = mobility(v) * protrusion_radial(v) applied downward (alpha 0.40) with an umbilical deepening term (0.12) at the navel, plus an inward radial tuck (beta 0.35) below the crease line h_c = h_navel - 0.13; slope-limited (|sag(u)-sag(v)| <= 0.55 * edge length) and volume-matched to v1 by construction (radial compensation solved to -0.06 cm, i.e. nil; signed-volume proxy ratio v2/v1 = 1.000)

makehuman_hm08.base: hm08 (MPFB2 base.obj vertex order, 19158 verts; instance is a pure delta vs the macro-neutral base)

components.combined_at_+1: body.belly.protrusion_v2.target (= protrusion + sag, for hosts without coupling support)

folds.+1.05: flips appear (10 raw / 8 macro) -- outside the shipped slider range
folds.+1_combined: 0 flipped faces over 1092 belly faces on BOTH bases (min_dot raw 0.005, macro 0.003 -- fold-free but thinner margin than v1's 0.055/0.089); Blender evaluated belly-region cross-check: 0 flips over 918 faces, min_dot 0.020
folds.-1_linear: 157 raw / 142 macro flips -- inherited from v1, see negative_side

qa.load_test: Loads via stock MPFB2 (2.0.18) TargetService.load_target as shape keys; Blender-verified measurements above. Environment note: in this VM the shared Blender config's MPFB was replaced by a newer-API build mid-session; the v2 test ran against the zip's 2.0.18 in an isolated HOME under xvfb (see scripts/test_belly_v2.py header).

navel_anchor.note: the v2 anchor is a VECTOR: the navel keeps the v1 forward anchor (<=1.3 mm error in numpy, 0.2 mm in Blender) and additionally migrates DOWN 2.95 cm at +1 -- the gravity signature v1 lacked

qa.negative_side: At -1 the reversed combined field folds (157/1092 faces). Same standing fix as v1: a production negative pole must be a separately authored decrease target. Additionally, hosts should clamp the sag component to w >= 0 until that target exists (a reversed sag would lift the belly, which is the decrease shape's own business).

residual_forward_cm_zone_split.method: triangle-exact, torso-param space, mask core w>0.5, same machinery as v1 (v1 aggregate recomputed as control: p50 0.039 / p95 1.394, matches PROOF.md)
residual_forward_cm_zone_split.note: v2 residuals vs the (gravity-free) source surface grow BY DESIGN: the sag deliberately departs from the studied shape. Zone means show the departure is the sag itself (pin patch verts carry the navel's 3.2 cm sag). Read v2 residuals as 'distance from the uncorrected transfer', not as error.

volume_proxy.method: signed tetrahedral volume over the mask patch about the navel axis point

label: Belly

provenance.licence: study-only (internal) - NOT a CC0 MakeHuman asset; do not ship or redistribute
provenance.method: v1: non-rigid registration in torso-param space onto the source fat surface, tight navel pin, dual-base fold repair. v2 gravity pass: procedural mobility field x protrusion-scaled downward sag + umbilical term + sub-crease radial tuck; slope limiter; volume matching; attenuation fold repair; nonlinear runtime coupling gamma 1.7
provenance.source: Fat Males body morph (learned, exact-topology delta vs Skyrim male base) -- v1 transfer unchanged; v2 adds an AnthroForge-authored analytic gravity pass (no external asset)

range.endpoint_anchor: max forward displacement at navel = 0.156 m on the source base (Fat Males); scaled by torso-length ratio s = 0.8325 to 0.1197 m on hm08

region.mask_rule: geodesic falloff from navel landmark, r = 0.35 x torso_len; full weight inside 0.65r, cosine falloff to 0 at r

semantics: Forward protrusion of the abdominal wall centred on the navel, WITH gravity: as weight grows the mass hangs -- the apex migrates below the navel, the navel itself travels down as well as out, the top slope flattens, and the lower rows drop and tuck inward to form the under-belly crease. Realised as two coupled components: the v1 protrusion field (linear in w) plus a sag component applied with the nonlinear coupling f(w) = sign(w)*|w|^1.7, so at +0.5 the belly protrudes half but sags only ~31% of its full drop, and at 0 there is no sag at all. One-sided source morph: the negative pole remains NOT production-safe (see qa.negative_side).
